run_gen_settings_ids: run the python script to generate HTTP/2 settings C header and source files for gRPC
run_put_banner: run the put_banner function to write a comment block into a list of output files
run_hash: run the hash function to compute a perfect hash value for a given setting ID
review_SETTINGS: review the _SETTINGS dictionary to understand HTTP/2 setting definitions like HEADER_TABLE_SIZE and MAX_FRAME_SIZE
review_DecoratedSetting: review the DecoratedSetting namedtuple structure that wraps setting enums, names, and parameters
